title.narrative: Increased capacity of Member States to extend labour protection to groups of workers facing a high risk of exclusion

description.narrative: The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area. (1) Expansion of knowledge on protecting workers’ personal data and right to privacy in the digital era and on ensuring fair use of algorithms. (2) Research and dissemination of information on the platform economy, including its trends and effects on workers, firms and labour market performance, and on practices and innovations to ensure adequate protection of platform workers. (3) Expansion of knowledge on the role of the employment relationship as a means of providing certainty and legal protection to workers. (4) Research on the interplay between the evolution of work arrangements, the growth of the platform economy, the development of new technologies and the prevalence of informality.
